title: Notty Identifier
description: Advanced IP-based anti-alt protection with real-time Discord webhook alerts.
body:
Notty Identifier is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft security plugin designed to detect and control alternate account abuse using IP-based tracking.

When a player joins for the first time, their UUID and IP address are securely stored. If another account attempts to join using the same IP, the plugin can either block the login or notify staff instantly via Discord webhook.

Built for SMP, Lifesteal, Economy, and competitive servers that require strong moderation tools.

# ✨ Features

🔐 Automatic UUID + IP registration

🚫 Prevents alternate account login from same IP

📢 Instant Discord webhook alerts

⚙ Fully configurable messages

🧠 Smart Detection Mode (reduces false positives)

📂 Clean YAML configuration

🛡 Bypass permission support

⚡ Lightweight & optimized
